status: Exploratory extension after inspection of the original dataset; fixed before fitting the new models, not a preregistration
split: Group identical nominal support sets across plates; full-support controls always in training; shuffle groups with PCG64 seed then greedy balance sample counts
parameters: Six log efficiency ratios per plate, shared contamination fraction eta and six log contamination ratios; DM adds shared concentration kappa
bounds: log efficiency and contamination ratios [-12,12]; 0<eta<0.2 via 0.2*sigmoid; kappa in [1,10000000]
heldout_inference: Unknown seven-taxon composition; no nominal support mask. Invert simultaneous count and beta intervals, subtract fitted contamination and divide by fitted efficiency
nuisance_bootstrap: 100 parametric fixed-design training refits per fold for the DM model; envelope across every refit plus original fit; sensitivity envelope, no claimed 95% nuisance confidence set
metrics: heldout log probability of counts at nominal composition
limits: Two plates from one experiment, nominal rather than remeasured truths, fixed mixtures and shared fits; no independent validation of general coverage or biological cause of stray reads. No novelty or complete BIOCAT-68 solution claim.
